general.notes: Copper (electrical) Grey SFP; transmission media Electrical (1x RJ45). Power consumption stated as < 1W (no exact numeric). SO-SFP-100BASE-T operating temperature -10°C to +70°C; SO-SFP-100Base-T-I (-T-I) operating temperature -40°C to +85°C. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Distance 10M and Distance 100M both 100m CAT5 UTP. RX_LOS Yes; Auto-neg Yes (on line i/f); DDM No. Transceivers with manufacturing date Nov 2019 or more recent also support half-duplex configurations. bit_rate_gbps derived from stated 10-Megabit and 100-Megabit Ethernet (10 Mbps, 100 Mbps). reach_km from stated 100m typical reach and CAT5 distances.
general.suggestions: Consider schema fields for copper SFP (transmission_media electrical, CAT5 UTP, auto-negotiation, half-duplex) and separate temp_min_c/temp_max_c per SKU or list form for C-temp vs I-temp variants.
